lines.en: Okay, you know what? I'll have toast.
Oh, my God! Oh, my God!
Oh, my God! Oh, my God! Oh, my God!
Oh, my God! Oh, my God!
You guys! You guys!
We were just in the storage area,
and we saw this really creepy man.
He was like this crazy-eyed, hairy beast man.
He was like a... like a Bigfoot or a Yeti or something.
And he came at us with an ax,
so Rachel had to use a bug bomb on him.
Yeah, I pulled the tab and I just fogged his Yeti ass.
Uh, like dark hair, bushy beard?
Yeah. Yeah, you fogged Danny.
Oh, please. We did not fog Danny.
Who's Danny?
Danny just moved in downstairs.
Yeah, he just got back from, like,
this four-month trek in the Andes.
Nice fella.
Oh, he's nice. He's nice.
You know, you always...
stick up for the people we fog.
